 Live .  37,999 viewing 37999 viewing EFL Cup: Fleetwood stun Arsenal on penalties to reach quarter-finals

 Scores 
 Summary
 League Two Fleetwood stun Arsenal to reach EFL Cup quarter-finals
 Lowest-ranked side won on penalties after 1-1 draw
 Dowman sent off for Gunners on 85 mins
 Match was delayed for eight minutes due to drone flying nearby 
 Report: Bradford into last eight with 2-0 win over Peterborough
 Quarter-final draw will take place after Wednesday's games

 Tim: We don't talk about Bruno('s penalty)
 Ben: As an Arsenal fan, well done Fleetwood.
Embarrassing for us, shocking performances from all bar Odegaard, Arsenal u21s beat a higher ranked team earlier today...The red didn't change result but never a red, the tackle was only thing worth a red.

 'This is exactly what this whole town was hoping for' published at 22:27 GMT 22:27 GMT 
 FT: Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal (5-3 pens) 
 Leon Osman 
Former Everton midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 This is exactly what this whole town was hoping for, and you can see it in the celebrations.
 The players are still enjoying themselves, they still haven't gone down the tunnel.
 Sometimes you get that little bit of luck in football, sometimes it all comes together and that is why we love cup competitions. When the best of the best can play any team, they get drawn out against.
